name: Triage Orchestrator
description: Triage office — cron-driven agents that run the maintainer-bot loop end-to-end (sync → review → apply) on every configured target. No backend; declarative agents that consume the kernel_triage_* tools.
long_description:
Office that owns the triage maintainer-bot loop on a fixed cadence:

- :00 of every hour — kernel_triage_sync against every enabled target.
- :17 — pick items due for review (never reviewed, or updated since last review) and run kernel_triage_review on each.
- :37 — apply pending high-confidence proposed closes with dry_run=false, snapshot-guarded and throttled.

Uses Anthropic Haiku 4.5 as the agent driver; the actual LLM review uses whatever the kernel's LlmClient is configured with.
author: Kernl
